verdict.rationale: PayPal provides webhooks for event notifications (paypal-docs-9, paypal-docs-28) and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server enabling agents to call PayPal APIs via function calling (paypal-gh-1, paypal-gh-2, paypal-docs-10), which could theoretically be used to monitor payment events and trigger custom logic. However, there is no documented feature for detecting failed payments specifically, automated retry logic, or dunning outreach workflows in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit failed-payment/webhook event types for payment failure, built-in retry/dunning API or docs, first-party guidance on using webhooks+agent toolkit for dunning campaigns.
